facts.fact: Connecting Africa reports that Airtel Money Africa and PawaPay launched inbound remittances into Congo Brazzaville on 7 August 2025, letting licensed international money transfer operators pay into Airtel Money wallets.

Connecting Africa reports that Airtel Money Africa and PawaPay launched inbound remittances into Gabon on 7 August 2025, letting licensed international money transfer operators pay into Airtel Money wallets.

Connecting Africa reports that Airtel Money Africa and PawaPay launched inbound remittances into Malawi on 7 August 2025, letting licensed international money transfer operators pay into Airtel Money wallets.

Connecting Africa reports that Airtel Money Africa and PawaPay launched inbound remittances into Rwanda on 7 August 2025, letting licensed international money transfer operators pay into Airtel Money wallets.

Connecting Africa reports that Airtel Money Africa and PawaPay launched inbound remittances into Tanzania on 7 August 2025, letting licensed international money transfer operators pay into Airtel Money wallets.

Connecting Africa reports that Airtel Money Africa and PawaPay launched inbound remittances into Uganda on 7 August 2025, letting licensed international money transfer operators pay into Airtel Money wallets.

Connecting Africa reports that Airtel Money Africa and PawaPay launched inbound remittances into Zambia on 7 August 2025, letting licensed international money transfer operators pay into Airtel Money wallets, and that Western Union, Zoona and Chipper Cash launched international transfers in Zambia in July 2025.
